info.title: sentin8-storage
info.description: Sentin8 Sentin8:Storage - object/file storage with pluggable adapters.

get.description:
List buckets.

list buckets (top-level prefixes).
This is a dedicated handler because the route `/v1/admin/buckets` also
has a POST handler, so the catch-all `/v1/admin/{resource}` route is
shadowed for GET requests.
List buckets.

create a bucket by placing a `.keep` marker
object at the bucket path. Returns an RFW redirect to the buckets list.

AdminDataRows.description:
The `GET /v1/admin/{resource}` rows payload: the per-resource row
documents the RFW DataTable renders (row cells and per-resource
column sets are service-defined; the RFW renderer reads them
dynamically).

AdminUiResponse.description:
The response from an admin UI endpoint.

- `GET /v1/admin/ui/{page}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(page_def)`
- `POST /v1/admin/{resource}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(updated_page_def)` or `AdminUiResponse::Redirect(route)`

LiveHealth.description:
The `GET /v1/health` liveness payload every service returns: the
status string, the serving service's short name, build identity, and
(when the process tracks them) the count of live connections.
`service` and `active_connections` stay absent when a service does
not set them (e.g. the bus mounts the generic handler).

active_connections.description: Live socket count when the traffic counter is mounted.

service.description:
The serving service's short name (absent when the generic handler
does not carry one).
